why: Replace the scaffold placeholders in overview.md, domains/README.md and standards/README.md of mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails with content read from the node.

ops.body: Don't Count Eggs on Rails is an Oxygen Not Included mod: critter sensors no longer count eggs that are riding a conveyor rail through the room. Eggs on the floor, in incubators or carried by duplicants count as before. It patches `OvercrowdingMonitor.UpdateRegion`. Version 0.1.0 in `mod_info.yaml` (released 2026-10-09), minimum supported build 744825, published on the Steam Workshop.

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/DontCountEggsOnRails/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` holds the entry point and the `OvercrowdingMonitor.UpdateRegion` patch; `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/DontCountEggsOnRails.Tests/`: in-game tests (`Eggs.cs`).
- `preview/`: before and after screenshots and the preview image with its source.
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and the packaged mod.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

Documents in this folder:

- [entities](entities.md): Rail eggs excluded from critter sensor counts, with the key code paths.
- [glossary](glossary.md): How rail eggs are kept out of room counts.

Documents in this folder:

- [code-style](code-style.md): C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions, with this mod's own layout.
- [error-handling](error-handling.md): How the mod guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing.
- [naming-conventions](naming-conventions.md): File, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming.
